[News releases](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases)


22 October 2026


# IHG Hotels & Resorts Partners with American Express to Elevate Premium Travel Experiences for Card Members in Mainland China


**22 October 2026, Shanghai –** IHG Hotels & Resorts announced a partnership with American Express in Mainland China, bringing together premium Card Member benefits and IHG’s hotel experiences to deliver more rewarding and exclusive travel experiences for high-value travelers. The partnership will offer eligible American Express® Platinum Cardmembers a complimentary status match to IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite status, unlocking a range of exclusive member benefits across more than 7,000 IHG hotels worldwide. Eligible American Express Cardmembers can also enjoy a limited-time cashback offer at participating IHG properties. This collaboration also marks the first time IHG One Rewards has partnered with an international card network on a status match initiative in Mainland China.


IHG Hotels & Resorts Partners with American Express to Elevate Premium Travel Experiences for Card Members in Mainland China[download](https://www.ihgplc.com/~/media/Images/I/Ihg-Plc/images/news/2026/ihg-partners-with-american-express-in-mainland-china-landing-image.jpg)


**Rita Jiang, Chief Commercial & Marketing Officer, Greater China, IHG Hotels & Resorts** , said: *“As travel continues to evolve, consumers increasingly value recognition and meaningful benefits throughout their journeys. With our global hotel network, diverse brand portfolio and IHG One Rewards, we continue to create rewarding experiences across every travel occasion. We are delighted to partner with Amex (Shanghai) Bankcard Clearing and Settlement Company Limited, American Express’s joint venture in Mainland China(“Amex”), on a status match that extends premium Cardmember recognition into hotel experience and brings our two membership ecosystems closer together.”*


**Yamin Zhu, Chief Executive Officer of Amex (Shanghai) Bankcard Clearing and Settlement Company Limited** , said: “ *Our collaboration with IHG reflects our continued focus on the needs of Card Members* *. As part of our refreshed Platinum Card offer, we are enhancing benefits across travel, dining and lifestyle,* *to deliver greater value and more rewarding experiences. The addition of IHG further strengthens our travel proposition, offering Card Members greater recognition and exclusive benefits wherever their journeys take them.”*


Bringing together two leading global brands in travel, payments and premium lifestyle, the partnership is designed to meet the evolving needs of premium travellers in Mainland China. Eligible American Express Platinum Cardmembers in Mainland China can register for a complimentary status match to IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite status, with benefits including 60% bonus points on qualifying stays and a welcome amenity, as well as room upgrades and late check-out, subject to hotel availability. The matched status is valid through 31 December 2027, and members who complete 10 qualifying nights between September 15, 2026 and December 31, 2027, subject to applicable offer terms, can extend their Platinum Elite status through 31 December 2028.


In addition to the elite status match, American Express Cardmembers can enjoy an exclusive, limited-time cashback offer. From now until December 31, 2026, upon successful registration, eligible Cardmembers in Mainland China who spend at least RMB 1,800 at participating IHG properties using their American Express Card will receive RMB 370 cashback. The offer is available at properties across Regent Hotels & Resorts, Vignette Collection, Kimpton Hotels, and select InterContinental Hotels & Resorts in Greater China, as well as participating luxury hotel brands in popular international destinations including Australia, Japan and Singapore.


IHG One Rewards now has more than 160 million members worldwide. The partnership with Amex reflects IHG’s continued focus on strengthening the IHG One Rewards program for premium travelers in Mainland China. IHG will continue to respond to evolving guest needs and collaborate with partners to broaden the benefits available to members throughout their journeys.


Terms and limitations apply to all benefits. Log on to the Amex China Mini Program for complete details.
